what happens: Hat-tip: one hand on the brim of his beret, tipping it down over one eye, the other arm out, one knee bent, cool smile
Spin: turning on one foot, arms tucked in, curved motion lines around him
Toe stand: up on the tips of both toes, knees together, one hand on his beret, eyes closed, very proud
The impossible lean: leaning far forward from straight legs, feet flat on the ground, arms at his sides, as if glued to the floor
Moonwalk glide, step one: sliding backwards, one foot flat and the other on its toes, arms swinging, a smooth smile
Moonwalk glide, step two: the feet swapped, still sliding backwards (it alternates with D5)
Arm wave: a wave rolling through both arms held out to the sides, like a ripple, little motion lines
Points to the sky with one arm straight up, the other hand on his hip, feet apart, a star-like freeze
Rubber legs: a wild shimmy, his legs bending like spaghetti, knees wobbling, a huge grin, wiggle lines
Jazz hands: both hands open wide next to his face, fingers spread, eyes wide, the biggest grin, small sparkles
Tornado spin: spinning so fast his body is a blur in a little whirlwind, only his happy face and beret clear
Knee slide: sliding forward on his knees, arms flung out wide, leaning back, mouth open singing
Tiptoe sneak: tiptoeing lightly on the high notes, one foot raised, a finger to his lips, a playful look
Tiptoe sneak, the other foot: the next light step (it alternates with D13)
Winding up: crouched low, coiled like a spring, hands on knees, ready to burst, eyes shining
The big finish: a freeze pose, one arm up pointing, the other on his beret, one leg kicked to the side, sparkles
